reply.text:
I'm not going to build a plan around getting skinny fast and being hungry. Chasing a thigh gap and being fine with hunger is a pattern that needs a doctor or a registered dietitian, not a coach. Please talk it through with one, and I'll still be here.

A thigh gap also mostly comes down to bone structure, so no amount of training or eating less will guarantee one. Once you've talked with them, I'm glad to help with the training side, whether that's getting stronger, building a routine you enjoy, or running.
